info.title: cohesive-sim
info.description: Import and validate retained catalogs and create, provision, and verify portable deterministic Cohesive simulation artifacts.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Create and provision deterministic Cohesive world artifacts.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: manifest
commands.description: Create and retain a verified world-artifact manifest.

options.name: --world
options.description: Portable core world-definition JSON path, or '-' for standard input.

options.name: --relationship-world
options.description: Portable relationship-world JSON path, or '-' for standard input.

options.name: --out
options.description: World-artifact manifest JSON path, or '-' for standard output.

options.name: --seed
options.description: Deterministic signed 64-bit root seed. [required from any configuration source]

commands.name: provision
commands.description: Provision a retained world-artifact manifest as JSON Lines.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Verified world-artifact manifest JSON path, or '-' for standard input. [required from any configuration source]

options.name: --out
options.description: Verified-manifest JSON Lines output path, or '-' for standard output.

options.name: --target
options.description: Stable logical identity of this JSON Lines destination. [required from any configuration source]

options.name: --batch-size
options.description: Positive provisioning batch size.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Verify world JSON Lines against an independently retained manifest.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Verified world-artifact manifest JSON path, or '-' for standard input. [required from any configuration source]

options.name: --jsonl
options.description: World JSON Lines path to verify, or '-' for standard input. [required from any configuration source]

commands.name: catalog
commands.description: Import, inspect, and validate retained generation catalogs.

options.name: --catalog
options.description: Generation-catalog document JSON path, or '-' for standard input. [required from any configuration source]

commands.name: import-external
commands.description: Import and retain a catalog from a bounded external provider process.

options.name: --definition
options.description: Portable external catalog-import definition JSON path, or '-' for standard input. [required from any configuration source]

options.name: --executable
options.description: Provider executable file name or path, launched directly without a command shell. [required from any configuration source]

options.name: --arg
options.description: Ordered provider argument; repeat the option for multiple arguments.

options.name: --working-directory
options.description: Optional provider-process working directory.

options.name: --timeout-seconds
options.description: Positive provider wall-clock limit in seconds, no greater than one day.

options.name: --maximum-message-bytes
options.description: Positive maximum bytes accepted for a provider request or response.

options.name: --maximum-standard-error-bytes
options.description: Positive maximum provider standard-error bytes retained for diagnostics.

options.name: --out
options.description: Canonical generation-catalog JSON path, or '-' for standard output.
